In [3]:
size = 112
tiles = []

for r in range(10):
    for c in range(10):
        bbox = (c*size, r*size, (c+1)*size, (r+1)*size)
        tiles.append(img.crop(bbox))

print(len(tiles))
print(tiles[0].size)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(9, 3))
for ax, i in zip(axes, [0, 1, 10]):
    ax.imshow(tiles[i], cmap="gray")
    ax.set_title(f"tile {i}")
    ax.axis("off")
plt.show()

axes[0].set_title("original")
axes[0].axis("off")
axes[1].imshow(flip0, cmap="gray", vmin=0, vmax=255)
axes[1].set_title("flipped")
axes[1].axis("off")
plt.show()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 4, figsize=(10, 5))

for j, i in enumerate([0, 1, 7, 99]):
    axes[0, j].imshow(xrays[i], cmap="gray", vmin=0, vmax=255)
    axes[0, j].set_title(f"original {i}")
    axes[1, j].imshow(xrays_flipped[i], cmap="gray", vmin=0, vmax=255)
    axes[1, j].set_title(f"flipped {i}")

for ax in axes.ravel():
    ax.axis("off")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

matches = list(re.finditer(r"CHAPTER [IVXLC]+", body))

chapters = []
for i, m in enumerate(matches):
    if i + 1 < len(matches):
        stop = matches[i + 1].start()
    else:
        stop = len(body)
    chapters.append(body[m.end():stop])

print(len(chapters))
print([len(c) for c in chapters])
print(chapters[0][:200])

In [19]:
chapter_scores = []

for ch in chapters:
    sents = nltk.tokenize.sent_tokenize(ch)
    scs = [sentiment(s)["compound"] for s in sents]
    chapter_scores.append(np.mean(scs))

print(len(chapter_scores))
print(np.round(chapter_scores, 3))

chapter_numbers = np.arange(1, len(chapter_scores) + 1)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))
plt.plot(chapter_numbers, chapter_scores, marker="o")
plt.axhline(0, color="gray", linestyle="--")
plt.xlabel("Chapter")
plt.ylabel("Mean sentence sentiment (VADER compound)")
plt.title("Sentiment by Chapter: Jane Eyre")
plt.xticks(chapter_numbers[::2])
plt.show()
